observations: Single-cylinder diesel engine with an electric starter motor.
High-pressure triplex plunger pump connected to the engine via a dual-belt drive.
The entire assembly is mounted on a black-painted square-tube steel frame.
The engine has a blue fuel tank and a black air filter/muffler housing.
A yellow warning tag is attached to the engine's fuel line area.
Identification plates are visible on the engine block and the pump body, but the text is illegible.
The image is watermarked with 'CHINOTEX INDUSTRIAL'.

claims.evidence: The machine appears clean, but there is no packaging or documentation to confirm it has never been used.
A starter motor and wiring are visible on the engine in photo 0.
Diesel engines of this design are four-stroke; 'single stroke' is likely a typo for 'single cylinder'.

claims.claim: High pressure pump machine for washing bays
claims.evidence: The configuration of a diesel engine driving a plunger pump is standard for commercial car wash operations.

risks.risk: Unknown engine horsepower and pump pressure/flow specifications
risks.proof: Clear, legible photos of the data plates on both the engine and the pump.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest capacity/specification model of this type

risks.risk: Engine or pump may be non-functional
risks.proof: A video showing the engine starting via the key and the pump discharging water at high pressure.

risks.risk: Missing battery and accessories (hoses, spray gun)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories, specifically the battery required for the electric start.
risks.if_unproven: as the bare machine only, without battery or hoses

proof_requests: Legible photo of the engine's identification plate showing horsepower (HP) and model.
Legible photo of the pump's identification plate showing pressure (Bar/PSI) and flow rate (L/min).
Video of the machine starting and spraying water.
Photo of all included accessories, including the battery and hoses.
response.reason: The specific model and performance ratings (HP and pressure) are not legible on the data plates, and these specifications are the primary drivers of the item's value.
